subject: FA3-CHANGE-HISTORY-INTELLIGENCE-001
decision: Materialize CHIF as a shared, deterministic, derived and rebuildable Change-History Intelligence layer under FA3-JOURNAL-001 with no new capability or architectural authority.
rationale: FA3 needs one cross-cutting answer to what changed, why, what it affects, which evidence is current, and what rollback/requalification is required.
The layer must explain canonical and runtime history without becoming a second Journal, Evidence, Canonical Registry, License & Rights, Current Host or release authority.
Exact provenance, structured event semantics and explicit lineage improve traceability while avoiding manufactured dependencies.
